name: go-code-review
description: Auto-review Go code for 100+ common mistakes from 100go.co. Checks error handling, concurrency, interfaces, performance, testing, and stdlib usage with severity tiers and direct mistake references.

interface.shortDescription: Review Go code for common mistakes
interface.longDescription: Reviews Go files and PRs against 100+ common mistakes from 100go.co and real-world OSS patterns, and reports each finding with severity, file:line, mistake number, and a suggested fix.
defaultPrompt: Use $go-code-review to review these Go changes for common mistakes.
Use $go-code-review to check handler.go for error handling and concurrency issues.
Use $go-code-review to review the Go files in this PR and rank findings by severity.
